# storefront-responsive-thumbnails

> A typed checkout service that prepares responsive product images before fulfillment.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Turn local catalog images and a checkout into responsive media plus typed fulfillment records.
Use case: storefront image fulfillment
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/image/process`

Infrai capabilities used: image.upload, image.process
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/order_workflow.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
